scope: Seven listed screenshot topics; read-only original/final code and saved diagnostics plus primary principles; no new PDE production

seven_topics.finding: Low absolute temperature alone is not a negligibility criterion. D(T,C) is not a direct temperature-gradient mass flux. Diffusive enthalpy flux and latent heat are not synonymous with Dufour.
seven_topics.decision: Explicit baseline omission; require measured or bounded cross coefficients and flux/output sensitivity.
missing: cross coefficient definitions and values in material dry-basis convention

seven_topics.finding: Use qrad=epsilon sigma(Trad^4-Ts^4); low temperature does not prove negligible; supplied h is explicitly convective.
seven_topics.decision: Parent separately evaluates stated parameter scenarios; this review introduces no emissivity, wall temperature or view-factor measurements.

seven_topics.finding: Uniform affine R,L deformation requires rho_d R^2 L=constant. R(t) does not determine L(t) or internal velocities. Shortening L worsens the literal wet-density/dry-mass/volume bound.
seven_topics.decision: Keep fixed L as explicit assumption; do not claim radial data prove axial shrinkage absent.

seven_topics.topic: Single effective D and bound/free water
seven_topics.finding: One empirical total-water D is a closure, not evidence that phase partition, exchange kinetics and desorption/latent energy have all been calibrated.
seven_topics.decision: Do not assert mechanisms already fully absorbed without fitting/phase data.

seven_topics.finding: Cylindrical shape and axisymmetric fields do not prove isotropic transport or deformation. Scalar D,k are parsimonious supplied-property use; directional validation absent.
seven_topics.decision: Tensor/axial coefficients required for verified anisotropic extension; radial-only model probes radial effective coefficients.

seven_topics.finding: Internal +/-S cancel in a total-water balance with consistent control volume/basis, even without local phase equilibrium. Latent enthalpy does not disappear; temperature-form -Lv S or equivalent total-enthalpy storage/flux must be accounted once.
seven_topics.decision: Mass cancellation valid conditionally; inference that it removes energy latent heat is incorrect.

seven_topics.finding: Coefficient continuation prevents division by zero but float exp underflows; it neither clips accepted states nor proves positivity, stability or useful uniform parabolicity.
seven_topics.decision: Do not claim positive-diffusion guarantee; actual frozen production accepted states remain far above floor.

additional_distinction.vapor_equilibrium_temperature_driving: jv=-delta_p grad[aw(C,T) psat(T)] contains a temperature-gradient term by chain rule; this is not automatically molecular Soret and is not automatically captured by D(T,C) gradC.
additional_distinction.radiation_relation_to_rounding: Output to four decimals is a formatting convention; it does not bound any omitted physical mechanism.

actual_small_expression_check.operation: NumPy float64 exp(-a/1e-12) for a in [0.89,0.45,0.30], no PDE calls

saved_production_diagnostics.scope: Existing actual accepted-state diagnostics, freshly read; no rerun

primary_sources.title: COMSOL Multicomponent Thermal Diffusion
primary_sources.use: Definition of Soret and need for thermal diffusion coefficients

primary_sources.title: Van-Brunt, Farrell, Monroe: Consolidated theory of fluid thermodiffusion
primary_sources.use: Soret/Dufour definitions; force/flux conventions and why arbitrary concentration-temperature coefficients are not simply Onsager-equal; not herbal parameters

primary_sources.title: COMSOL How to Model Heat and Moisture Transport in Porous Media
primary_sources.use: Vapor pressure driving, phase transport and equilibrium/non-equilibrium concepts; not herb calibration

primary_sources.title: COMSOL Hygroscopic Porous Medium
primary_sources.use: Total moisture and cancellation of phase-change mass sources

primary_sources.title: COMSOL Theory for Moist Porous Media Heat and Moisture Coupling
primary_sources.use: Distinct latent source, vapor saturation and diffusive enthalpy coupling

primary_sources.title: COMSOL Surface-to-Ambient Radiation
primary_sources.use: Radiation boundary mechanism and required emissivity/environment temperature

limitations: No claim of four-decimal physical accuracy
No full all-state numerical positivity proof
